description: A clay-loaded, glazed printing paper that takes fine halftone impressions but handles poorly: Cockerell records it as fragile, prone to flaking and staining, and unsuitable for books meant to last.
name: art paper

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter II, p.48. Internet Archive.
